target: docs/41-试点课堂Start持久迁移内核SDD.md
scope: read-only review of catalog cross-process locking, lock ordering, concurrency, restart verification, and sync failure semantics

findings.title: Case-open sequence does not explicitly recheck catalog after acquiring the case lock
findings.recommendation: Specify catalog snapshot under lock and release, acquire case OS lock, re-read/revalidate catalog under catalog lock, then release catalog lock and OpenVerified/open DB. Never authorize an open using the pre-lock snapshot.

implementation_gates: Freeze OS lock primitive and semantics (Windows handle lock; POSIX flock/fcntl) on supported local filesystems.
Race two supervisor processes on same-case cleanup/open and prove catalog recheck after case-lock acquisition.
Run different-case parallel append/DB work and restart full-chain verification.
Fault-inject zero-byte, partial-frame, and uncertain-sync append outcomes; fail closed on ambiguous tail.
